items.review_rationale: Read countably supported discrete orthogonal polynomial system with distinct real support points, strictly positive summable weights and all finite moments, degree-n polynomials and pairwise weighted sum zero.

references.context: Infinite collection of distinct real points with a countable enumeration, as opposed to interval or measure-only support.
Strictly positive real weight attached to each x in X.
For every nonnegative integer k, weighted nonnegative sum over countable support converges to a finite real number.
Pairwise zero weighted inner products for distinct degrees n,m over the countable support.

references.disposition: Polynomials have exact prescribed degrees, not merely bounded degrees.

items.review_rationale: Read finite discrete orthogonal polynomial system over exactly N+1 distinct real support points with positive weights, degree n polynomials and zero pairwise weighted sums only for indices zero through N.

references.phrase: support X of N+1 distinct real points
references.context: Finite set of support points indexed by the number N+1, no repetitions.
Strictly positive scalar for each support point x.
For distinct n,m in {0,…,N}, sum over x∈X of p_n(x)p_m(x)w_x vanishes.

references.phrase: finite system supports at most degrees through N
references.disposition: The given system has N+1 polynomials and does not assert orthogonality of indefinitely many degrees on N+1 points.

items.review_rationale: Read interval-weight orthogonal system with nonnegative integrable weight, strictly positive finite total mass, all finite weighted moments, exact degree sequence and vanishing pairwise weighted integrals.

references.context: Open real interval which is the domain for weighted integrals.
Real function w on (a,b) satisfying integrability, positivity of total integral, and finite weighted moments.
For all positive integers k, absolute polynomial moments weighted by w are finite.
For distinct degrees n,m, the weighted integral of p_n p_m on (a,b) vanishes.

references.disposition: The source imposes 0<∫w<∞ and not mere nonnegativity of w pointwise.

items.review_rationale: Read measure-theoretic orthogonal system relative to Lebesgue–Stieltjes measure induced by bounded nondecreasing function with infinite growth support and finite moments, exact polynomial degrees and zero cross-moments.

references.phrase: nth raw moment of orthogonality measure

references.context: Measure induced by distribution-type monotone generating function meeting source admissibility constraints.
Underlying nondecreasing function has infinitely many points where it locally increases, ensuring nontrivial infinite orthogonality support.
All nonnegative integer absolute moments are finite.
Cross products of distinct-degree polynomials have zero integral under measure μ.

references.disposition: This variant is not simply the interval weight formulation; it specifies Lebesgue–Stieltjes origin and support conditions.
